newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. bond market closed in Tokyo for holiday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bond market closed in Tokyo for holiday.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury market was closed in Tokyo on Friday due to the Independence Day holiday in the United States and will reopen on Monday.

Expectations for higher U.S. rates dwindled and lifted bond prices up sharply overnight after Labor Department reported that nonfarm payrolls rose by 217,000 in June -- lower than expectations of as much as a 300,000 increase.
Dealers said the Treasury market is likely to drift firmly next week, focusing on inflation data and the dollar/yen exhange rate. -- Tokyo Treassury Desk 81-3-3432-1396
